description:
I’m Tanishka, and I support students through engineering admissions in Maharashtra with a calm and structured approach.
I help students understand CAP rounds, evaluate cutoffs, and shortlist colleges and branches that truly fit their profile.
During option filling, I focus on logic and priority rather than guesswork.
My guidance is practical, unbiased, and easy to understand.
I aim to make the admission journey less confusing and more confident for students.
